text:
Which statements explain why plastics should be recycled?
1
They do not decompose when added to land fill.
2
They pollute rivers and oceans, harming wildlife.
3
They can produce toxic gases when burned.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
